structureInventory.notes: Historical named features only, not a complete modern inventory or inferred correspondence with OSM ways.

gaps: Profile is a schematic 2013 vector chart with variable-width, overlapping strokes, not a surveyed longitudinal water-surface profile. Render independent segments; no synthetic continuous centerline or interpolated points was created.
No exact official mileposts downloaded for any plant. All mile fields deliberately null; chart-calibrated segment distances live only in profile.
Exact numerical lifts and pump counts remain null where no downloaded primary text supported them; Bouse/Little Harquahala/Hassayampa counts are historical contracted motors.

CAP lift/head figures differ across sources and conditions. Salt Gila 84 ft versus Story Map 75 ft is explicitly retained; Black Mountain 335 ft is maximum. Do not derive lift from chart vertices or silently sum all plant values.
Waddell is a storage branch; Snyder Hill and Black Mountain are adjacent facilities. Story order is not asserted hydraulic connectivity.

Only Buckskin Mountains Tunnel is explicitly named in retained OSM ways. Burnt Mountain, Agua Fria, Tucson Tunnel, and Centennial Wash/Jackrabbit Wash/Hassayampa/Agua Fria/New River/Salt River siphons are documented in USBR history but not confidently assigned to individual unnamed OSM segments.

OSM flooded=yes-like tags indicate underground water routing, not a certified inverted-siphon inventory. tunnel=yes may include short crossings. Generic names and provisional types remain unaltered; OSM way count must not be presented as CAP official tunnel/siphon count.

CAP GIS plant-coordinate item expressly prohibits redistribution without prior written consent. Dataset is for the requested private atlas research; secure permission or replace coordinates with a redistributable verified source before public publishing.

Legacy USBR Project.jsp data page returned 404; several CAP web requests returned 503. Primary PDFs, CAP-owned GIS and retained web_extract bodies supplied the usable evidence; no inaccessible source numbers were substituted.
Original exact Overpass queries were not provided; source snapshots preserve timestamps, tags, geometry, and canonical per-way URLs.
